zmx.comment: Pinned to a COMMIT, never a tag or branch: the patch below is line-addressed against this tree and scripts/build-zmx.sh --check-patches refuses any other.

ghostty.comment: zmx's own build.zig.zon pins this; we do not choose it. It differs on purpose from apps/terminal-core/native/upstream.lock.json (the CLIENT-side libghostty-vt pin) -- daemon-side and client-side VT versions are validated together in a later task, not forced equal here.

zig.provisioned_by: apps/terminal-core/native/common.sh (ensure_zig): pinned tarball + sha256 + minisign. This script REUSES that install and never fetches its own.
